content.en_US:
31x31x9 advanced fusion multiblock. It cannot select recipes or make plasma on its own; dock a [[Plasma Heater|Plasma Heater]] with its muzzle inside the inner ring cavity to inject plasma and sync the recipe.

10 ports in total (at the core's top/bottom center and ±2 offsets) accept power, fluids, and items.

Requires at least 64,000 mB of plasma to ignite, then consumes confinement power and cooling water (1,000 TU: 100 mB Water -> 10 mB Supercritical Steam; 64,000 mB base tank + 32,000 mB/tier) to output products and supercritical steam.

Accumulated neutron flux drives breeding: item breeding takes priority, otherwise the breeding fluid selected by the fluid identifier is transmuted. Stops if water runs out or steam is full.
content.zh_CN:
31x31x9 高阶核聚变多方块。本身不选配方也不制取等离子体，需由[[等离子加热器|Plasma Heater]]将炮口伸入环内空腔注入等离子体并同步配方。

接口共 10 个（核心顶/底面中心与 ±2 格处），可接入电力、流体与物品。

点火前等离子罐至少需攒够 64,000 mB 才会开机，并持续消耗约束电力与冷却水（1,000 TU：100 mB 水 → 10 mB 超临界蒸汽；基础水容 64,000 mB，每级 +32,000 mB），产出流体、物品与超临界蒸汽。

中子通量会累积用于增殖：优先处理增殖物品，否则处理流体识别码指定的增殖流体。水不足或蒸汽罐满时会停机。
